description: Arty loft renovated in 2025 in a 19th-century piano factory (no musical skills needed!). At the foot of Montmartre and Abbesses. 50 m² of calm with a boho touch. King-size bed, top-quality sofa bed, single bed + bunk beds. Quiet, elegant area near Pigalle and charming cobbled streets. Air conditioning, smart TV with Netflix—perfect for chilling after Montmartre’s stairs. Fast Wi-Fi (not as fast as you'll fall in love with the place).martreThe spaceWelcome to this unique loft, fully renovated in 2025, set in a former 19th-century piano factory. A 50 m² creative and peaceful retreat at the foot of Montmartre, just steps from Abbesses.Bright and spacious, the loft blends industrial charm with bohemian warmth and modern comfort. Ideal for couples, families, or friends looking to experience Paris in an authentic, inspiring way.It sleeps up to 6 people: king-size bed, top-quality sofa bed, single bed, and bunk beds. The space is quiet and cozy, with carefully chosen details to make you feel at home — or even better.You'll find a fully equipped kitchen, functional bathroom, air conditioning, extra fans, fast Wi-Fi, and a smart TV with Netflix. A travel crib can be provided on request for little travelers.The neighborhood is both elegant and lively: you're just a short walk from the Moulin Rouge, Pigalle, Montmartre’s iconic stairways, art galleries, and cafés full of character.Please note: out of respect for the building and neighbors, parties and events are strictly prohibited. This space is better suited for a quiet evening than a wild night out.A poetic and creative home base to experience Paris differently.Guest accessThe whole flat.Other things to noteRoyal for 1 or 2 peopleVery good for : a couple with 4 children / A group of 6 friendsGood for 2 couples Average for 3 cou
